- Purple/pinkish-purple banding running lengthwise along the tissue

- **Physoderma_Brown_Spot leaf** (2 images): showed banded yellowish spots on green leaf with dark midrib lesions — less matching
- **Tar_Spot** (1 image): black dots on green leaf background — black dots match but wrong background color/pattern

The Physoderma_Brown_Spot stem reference (scattered black spots on a purplish stalk/sheath) most closely resembles the test image. The KB description confirms it affects "leaf sheath and husks" with "dark purplish to black oval spots" that coalesce as disease progresses. The purple banding in the test image is consistent with coalesced lesions on a drying sheath.
